title: Legora and Superhuman Go integrate to bring quick legal insights to organizations
summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, announced a new legal intelligence agent for Superhuman Go
body_markdown:
Legal teams that use Superhuman Go and Legora will have access to legal intelligence right when they need it, without leaving their workflow.


Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, today announced a new legal intelligence agent for Superhuman Go, the AI assistant that works across the apps and websites people already use. The agent will proactively surface relevant information from a user's Legora workspace while writing an email, message, or document, giving them the resources and insights they need without switching tools.


The agent builds on Legora’s existing connector for Superhuman Go, which allows legal teams at mutual customers to ask questions about the text in front of them and get answers from Legora’s legal intelligence directly in the flow of their work.


Legal questions, whether they concern a clause in a counterparty's draft or come from a colleague, often arise in email and messaging platforms like Slack. Getting answers to these questions typically means having to download the file or paste the text into Legora. Legora’s integration with Superhuman Go removes that step, so users can ask a question right where it arrives and get an answer from Legora's legal intelligence. Users can also quickly check contract language against similar contracts their organization has drafted in Legora.


With the forthcoming agent, users will also see relevant information from their Legora workspace surface as they work, bringing matters, documents, and insights into context without requiring users to search for them. Because Superhuman Go allows anyone to build custom agents on its platform, users can also build their own agents alongside Legora’s to power additional use cases based on their unique workflows and requirements.


"For organizations of all sizes, legal questions come up all the time in email inboxes and messaging threads," said Gabriel Quek, Senior Director of Technology Partnerships at Legora. "Lawyers shouldn't have to download a file or paste text into Legora before they can get a quick answer. With this integration, they can use Legora's legal intelligence to answer questions about text on their screen."


Illustrative use cases include:


-


Quick checks on a counterparty's contract draft: A user receives a counterparty's draft by email and wants to check a clause before sending the draft to the legal team. They select the clause, ask Superhuman Go whether the organization has accepted that position before, and get an answer from Legora based on similar contracts the organization has drafted in Legora.


-


Answering a question in Slack: A colleague asks a legal question in a Slack thread, for example, about an obligation in a supplier's message. The recipient wants an initial answer before verifying with their legal team. They select the message, ask Superhuman Go, and get an answer from Legora without leaving Slack.


-


While drafting an email about a contract: A lawyer mentions an earlier agreement as precedent. Legora legal intelligence proactively surfaces the matter details and precedent terms from the lawyer’s Legora workspace, including the key terms, open issues, and how they compare to the current redline. The lawyer can copy those insights directly into the email, getting legal context at the moment it’s needed, without switching tools.


"Superhuman Go is built to help people in the apps where they already work,” said Jessica Gates, Head of Technology Partnerships at Superhuman. “Legal teams field questions in their inbox, in Slack, and in the documents they receive every day. With the Legora connector and agent, mutual customers will be able to get Legora’s answers to those questions and quickly access the resources they need as they work, without switching apps.”


The Legora connector is available today in the Superhuman Store to organizations that use both Superhuman Go and Legora. Further details about the Legora legal intelligence agent will be shared at a later date.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.
